b: Apex Tool Group has launched new Crescent and Gearwrench long-reach diagonal cutting pliers.
The Crescent tool joins their X2 pliers line and the Gearwrench tool is part of their Double-X range.
Both pliers have a compound-action 12-inch handle that lets you snip wires, zip ties, and other such things with greater reach.
The Crescent version is priced at around $19, and eligible for holiday season savings.
The Gearwrench version is a couple of dollars more, at a little over $21. It’s eligible for a similar holiday season discount promo.
I don’t know how practical long-reach diagonal cutters are, but I’m a big fan of long-reach pliers.
At the the time of this posting, Klein has the best deal on long-reach compound-action pliers, with this 2-piece set priced at $40 or $36 after instant coupon.
